entries.35249f7dfcd19723: Under its 9th Medium-Term Management Plan (fiscal years 2026–2028), the company's product strategy centers on core products such as feeding bottles and nipples and aims to raise customer lifetime value through products for older age stages; its regional strategy designates the Americas and Europe as priority regions, Singapore as a growth region, and Japan and China as stable growth regions; and it will advance the strengthening of its management foundation and ESG initiatives.

entries.454263a9aae51bb5: Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥109,170 million (up 4.8% year on year), and revenue from external customers by reportable segment was ¥41,098 million for the China Business, ¥36,360 million for the Japan Business, ¥21,884 million for the Ranshino Business and ¥9,826 million for the Singapore Business. By product category, childcare-related products were ¥101,558 million, childcare support ¥3,313 million, nursing care-related ¥3,951 million and other ¥347 million. Revenue by region was ¥36,360 million for Japan, ¥46,999 million for Asia, ¥13,825 million for North America and ¥11,984 million for other regions. The company disclosed PIP Co., Ltd. as a major customer, with revenue of ¥17,629 million.
